releaseNotes: 6D6X6 2.5.63.0: keeps the selected full bitrate on LAN and caps public provider routes at 8 Mbps to prevent video bursts from delaying mouse input. WASAPI audio now waits for a complete 20 ms Opus frame instead of padding partial frames with silence, uses packet-loss FEC, and keeps route-specific 60/80 ms buffers. Includes service, GameRemote.Host, CaptureWorker and all dependencies.
